title: MetLife Stadium
visualBrief: Specific MetLife Stadium: native asymmetric oval shell and field opening, three stepped open seating tiers/radial concrete aisles, suite/concourse bands, neutral standard football field/linework/two goalposts, four supported inward-facing corner boards, closed silver horizontal louver shell/recessed glazed entry bands/four major portal groups, continuous open steel lighting rim. Shared concrete/paint/window-grid/canvas graphs; canvas grain is a low-frequency artificial-turf approximation. No roof over field, furnished service interior, crowd, copied live screen/text/team/sponsor atlas, temporary event setup, other venue or whole parking lot/platform.
